messages.subject: mapBubbles: alter number of categories for nameZSize?
messages.subject_clean: mapBubbles: alter number of categories for nameZSize?
messages.body_plain:
Is it possible to change the number of categories for nameZSize, similar to numCats for nameZColour? I have a dataset that does not have a lot of variation, so the circle sizes do not vary by much, but I would like the highs and lows to be easier to see visually.

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] mapBubbles: alter number of categories for nameZSize?
messages.subject_clean: [rworldmap group] mapBubbles: alter number of categories for nameZSize?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Davina,
Interesting question.
The circle area is set to vary continuously according to the relative values in your data. You can increase the size of all the symbols using symbolSize= [>1] and that will make any differences between them more noticeable. I guess that if you subtracted the minimum value from all your datapoints (so that the smallest value is now 0) that might help too. If you want to post the data please do. Let us know if that helps/works.
Andy
